text_to_image_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one NEW high-resolution prop asset BOARD reconstructed for a cozy cat-care drama, not a crop or a storyboard. 4 columns × 3 rows, exactly 12 equal white cells, square or landscape canvas. Pure white seamless backgrounds, faint contact shadows, clean realistic product photography, matte natural materials, neutral soft daylight, no orange cast, no oily glossy CGI. Each cell contains ONLY the listed object or coherent set, fully visible and unobstructed with margin. Remove ALL cats, people, hands, body parts, rooms, scenery, dialogue, interface overlays, brands and watermarks. No labels or lettering except requested physical markings. Use the detailed shapes, colors and materials specified below. Rows left-to-right in this order: 1. cream narrow two-tier serving trolley, natural wood trays, raised rims, four black casters, completely empty; 2. sturdy low light-oak four-legged broad step stool; 3. small black nonstick frying pan with light metal exterior and short black handle fitted with gray silicone grip sleeve; 4. compact white round rice cooker with closed lid and plain small button; 5. cream enamel two-handled cooking pot with lid resting beside it; 6. short natural wood cooking spatula; 7. short black slotted spatula; 8. perforated silver metal colander with handles; 9. three different-size clear glass prep bowls empty nested loosely; 10. simple light-oak tilted phone stand EMPTY; 11. small stainless feeding spoon with pale-blue thick silicone loop grip handle; 12. plain light wood chopping board and small kitchen knife laid beside it. All functional coherent construction, no food or hands.

original_prompt: Edit target: the attached prop board. Preserve ALL twelve objects and their shapes colors materials and 4x3 layout exactly. Replace ALL background and all transparency with solid fully opaque pure white. Remove every black/red/yellow pixel artifact in the empty background. Normal RGB product photography on white background, soft neutral contact shadows. Do not make transparent cutouts. Fully opaque white canvas. No new objects.
